## Primary Services

### Web Design & Development
- **WordPress Development:** Custom theme architecture, speed optimization, and security hardening.
- **Custom Web Development:** Responsive, high-performance web applications and corporate websites.
- **E-Commerce Development:** Modern store experiences, fast checkout flows, and payment gateway integration.
- **Landing Page Design:** Conversion-rate optimized landing pages with direct WhatsApp and CRM integrations.

### Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
- **Local SEO:** Google Maps top 3 pack rankings, citation building, and regional keyword dominance in Vadodara and Gujarat.
- **On-Page SEO:** Technical meta tags, semantic HTML5, content depth, internal linking, and Schema.org markup.
- **Off-Page SEO:** High-authority backlink outreach and digital brand PR.
- **Technical SEO:** Core Web Vitals optimization, mobile responsiveness, XML sitemaps, and crawl efficiency.

### Google My Business (GMB) Optimization
- **GMB Setup & Verification:** Category mapping, NAP (Name, Address, Phone) consistency, and business optimization.
- **GMB Management:** Weekly geo-tagged photo posts, updates, and seasonal offers.
- **Review Management:** Reputation building, authentic customer feedback acquisition, and professional review responses.

### Graphic Design & Branding
- **Logo Design:** Vector brand marks, brand guides, and memorable visual iconography.
- **Brand Identity:** Complete corporate branding systems, typography, color palettes, and stationery.
- **Social Media Creatives:** High-converting Instagram, LinkedIn, and Facebook creatives and carousels.
- **Print Collateral:** Professional brochures, business cards, flyers, and event banners.
